status_values.read: an EXIT reader reads this value today; a change can be recorded from two reads
status_values.reserved: the name is fixed for a reader that is not live yet; it may be corrected only before its first record

value_types.solana_address_or_null: a Solana base58 address of 32 bytes, or null when no key is set; where a setting has zero_key_is_null (Token-2022 extension authorities, stored as a non-zero optional key), the all-zero key is written as null
value_types.evm_address: 0x and 40 lowercase hex digits; the zero address is a value, not an absence
value_types.evm_address_list: a list of evm_address values, sorted, without duplicates
value_types.u64_string: a decimal string without leading zeros, from "0" to "18446744073709551615"
value_types.enum: one of the strings listed in values
value_types.vote_threshold: {"kind": "YesVotePercentage" | "QuorumPercentage" | "Disabled", "percentage": 1..100, or null exactly when kind is Disabled}

settings.name: access-control:DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.members
settings.meaning: The full member set of the default admin role, only when every member was read.
settings.does_not_mean: Other roles, role admins, or who holds the keys.

settings.name: bpf-upgradeable-loader:programData.authority
settings.source: exit.solana-mint-research one-hop read: owner program upgrade authority
settings.meaning: The key that may replace the program's code. null: the loader accepts no further upgrade.
settings.does_not_mean: What the code does, or who holds the key.

settings.name: evm:eip1967.admin
settings.meaning: The EIP-1967 admin slot read as an address. The zero address: the slot is empty, not proof that no admin exists.
settings.does_not_mean: What the implementation code permits, or who controls the admin.

settings.name: evm:eip1967.beacon
settings.meaning: The EIP-1967 beacon slot read as an address. The zero address: the slot is empty.
settings.does_not_mean: What the implementation code permits, or who controls the admin.

settings.name: evm:eip1967.implementation
settings.meaning: The EIP-1967 implementation slot read as an address. The zero address: the slot is empty.
settings.does_not_mean: What the implementation code permits, or who controls the admin.

settings.name: evm:owner()
settings.meaning: The value the contract's owner() getter returned at the block.
settings.does_not_mean: That this address has any power the getter does not state.

settings.name: layerzero-v2:endpoint.delegates
settings.stored_in: the EndpointV2 contract named in scope.endpoint, keyed by the OApp (the subject)
settings.source: exit.layerzero-path-service/1: configuration.settings[layerzero-v2:endpoint.delegates]; selected EID/direction only (API installed 29 October 2026)
settings.meaning: The address the endpoint authorizes, besides the OApp itself, to change the OApp's libraries and verifier configuration and to skip, clear, nilify or burn its inbound messages. The zero address: no delegate.
settings.does_not_mean: Who controls the verifiers or the delegate, or that a message was forged.

settings.name: layerzero-v2:endpoint.getReceiveLibrary.isDefault
settings.stored_in: the EndpointV2 contract named in scope.endpoint, keyed by the OApp (the subject) and scope.eid
settings.source: exit.layerzero-path-service/1: configuration.settings[layerzero-v2:endpoint.getReceiveLibrary.isDefault]; selected EID/direction only (API installed 29 October 2026)
settings.meaning: true: the OApp has not set its own receive library and follows the endpoint default, which the endpoint owner can change; false: the OApp set a library, even if it equals the current default.
settings.does_not_mean: Who controls the verifiers or the delegate, or that a message was forged.

settings.name: layerzero-v2:endpoint.getReceiveLibrary.lib
settings.stored_in: the EndpointV2 contract named in scope.endpoint, keyed by the OApp (the subject) and scope.eid
settings.source: exit.layerzero-path-service/1: configuration.settings[layerzero-v2:endpoint.getReceiveLibrary.lib]; selected EID/direction only (API installed 29 October 2026)
settings.meaning: The receive library the endpoint uses for the OApp and remote endpoint id (the endpoint default when the OApp set none).
settings.does_not_mean: That it is the only library accepted: during a receive-library grace period the previous library is also accepted until its expiry block. Who controls the verifiers or the delegate.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.community_veto_vote_threshold
settings.source: exit.solana-governance-research/1 (GET /v0/research/solana/governance, live 29 October): governance.config.community_veto_vote_threshold (kind and percentage only)
settings.meaning: The percentage of the total eligible community vote weight (the maximum voter weight, not the votes cast) that community veto votes must reach to veto a council proposal. Disabled: the community cannot veto.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.community_vote_threshold
settings.source: exit.solana-governance-research/1 (GET /v0/research/solana/governance, live 29 October): governance.config.community_vote_threshold (kind and percentage only)
settings.meaning: The percentage of the total eligible community vote weight (the maximum voter weight, not the votes cast) that Yes votes must reach for a proposal to pass; Yes must also exceed No. Disabled: the community cannot vote on this governance's proposals.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.community_vote_tipping
settings.meaning: When a community vote may end before its voting period does.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.council_veto_vote_threshold
settings.source: exit.solana-governance-research/1 (GET /v0/research/solana/governance, live 29 October): governance.config.council_veto_vote_threshold (kind and percentage only)
settings.meaning: The percentage of the total eligible council vote weight (the maximum voter weight, not the votes cast) that council veto votes must reach to veto a community proposal. Disabled: the council cannot veto.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.council_vote_threshold
settings.source: exit.solana-governance-research/1 (GET /v0/research/solana/governance, live 29 October): governance.config.council_vote_threshold (kind and percentage only)
settings.meaning: The percentage of the total eligible council vote weight (the maximum voter weight, not the votes cast) that Yes votes must reach for a proposal to pass; Yes must also exceed No. Disabled: the council cannot vote on this governance's proposals.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.council_vote_tipping
settings.meaning: When a council vote may end before its voting period does.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.min_community_weight_to_create_proposal_raw
settings.meaning: The community voting weight (raw token units) needed to create a proposal.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.min_council_weight_to_create_proposal_raw
settings.meaning: The council voting weight (raw token units) needed to create a proposal.
settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.transactions_hold_up_seconds

settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.voting_base_seconds

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.config.voting_cool_off_seconds
settings.meaning: The period after the base voting time in which approving votes are no longer accepted (deny, veto and withdrawal still are).

settings.name: spl-governance:governance.required_signatories_count

settings.does_not_mean: Who votes, how a vote will go, or whether a proposal is safe.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm.council_mint
settings.meaning: The token mint whose holders form the council. null: no council.
settings.does_not_mean: Who holds the key or the council tokens.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm.realm_authority
settings.meaning: The key that may change the realm configuration (voter-weight and max-voter-weight plugins, token types, the community max-vote-weight source, removing the council, lock authorities), create governances without the minimum weight, and transfer or remove itself. It casts no vote by itself. null: none.
settings.does_not_mean: Who holds the key or the council tokens.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm_token_config.community.max_voter_weight_addin
settings.meaning: The plugin program that computes the maximum community voter weight, the denominator of every community threshold. null: no plugin; the maximum comes from the realm's community max-vote-weight source.
settings.does_not_mean: What the plugin code does, or who holds the tokens.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm_token_config.community.token_type
settings.meaning: Liquid: deposits and withdrawals are allowed. Membership: deposited tokens cannot be withdrawn, and the realm authority can revoke (burn) them. Dormant: the realm does not accept deposits of this token; a voter-weight plugin may still give it voting power.
settings.does_not_mean: What the plugin code does, or who holds the tokens.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm_token_config.community.voter_weight_addin
settings.meaning: The plugin program that computes voter weight. null: token deposits count directly.
settings.does_not_mean: What the plugin code does, or who holds the tokens.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm_token_config.council.max_voter_weight_addin
settings.meaning: The plugin program that computes the maximum council voter weight, the denominator of every council threshold. null: no plugin; the maximum is the council mint supply.
settings.does_not_mean: What the plugin code does, or who holds the tokens.

settings.name: spl-governance:realm_token_config.council.token_type

settings.name: spl-governance:realm_token_config.council.voter_weight_addin
settings.meaning: The plugin program that computes voter weight. null: token deposits count directly.
settings.does_not_mean: What the plugin code does, or who holds the tokens.
